summary.goal: Display real-time execution status on published plans (read-only overlay)
summary.context: If orchestrator provides status, steps show progress (done, running, waiting, blocked). This is read-only in Planner - execution is orchestrator's domain - but visibility keeps humans in the loop.

acceptance_criteria.description: Published plans fetch execution status from orchestrator
Step cards show status: done, running, waiting, blocked
Overall progress shown at plan level
Status updates in near real-time (polling or websocket)
Clear indication this is read-only view

steps.title: Define execution status types
steps.description: Define TypeScript types for step status: done, running, waiting, blocked.

steps.title: Create execution status API client
steps.description: API client to fetch execution status from orchestrator endpoint.

steps.title: Add status indicators to step cards
steps.description: Visual indicators on step cards showing execution status.

steps.title: Show overall progress on plan header
steps.description: Progress bar and step count on plan header showing overall execution progress.

steps.title: Implement polling for status updates
steps.description: Poll orchestrator for status updates at regular interval.

steps.title: Add read-only mode indicator
steps.description: Clear visual indication that execution view is read-only.
